clean_comparison: Oracle-support prior versus generic source prior, retaining the generic intercept, discrepancy and total function variance. Removing irrelevant directions and concentrating their variance are both part of this reference.
learned_comparison_limit: The same oracle prior also replaces the original ARD/mixture architecture; its comparison to risk_ard_mixture is not a support-only ablation.
finding: At 24 batches all five generic-control strata have positive mean predictive gains and nominal paired bootstrap intervals above zero; four learned-prior strata do, while separate-head structure has an interval crossing zero.
remaining_failures: Learned shared/52 and separate-risk/61 paths still lose held-out predictive score in the oracle diagnostic. No recommendation or verified-reward gains were evaluated.
